company.name: SentiLink
company.shortDescription: SentiLink is an identity verification technology company that helps in detecting and blocking synthetic identities.
company.description:
SentiLink is a technology company that helps in detecting and blocking synthetic identities. Its technology links with fraudulent crime rings to detect and block synthetic identities by searching for statistical anomalies through real-time application programming interfaces and risk analyst tools. This enables business clients to identify fake people and other connected fraudulent applications to harm the bottom line of the organizations.

The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: SentiLink Corp. is focused on enhancing identity verification technologies. Their research includes a system and method for detecting synthetic identities by determining a synthetic identity score for users. This score indicates the likelihood of a user employing a synthetic identity for various activities. The development aims to improve the detection and blocking of fraudulent identities, ensuring secure transactions and interactions.
